**Bottom line:** Market scores show elevated supply risk (71) and strong price rise pressure (84.7), so lock in pricing where advised and press for lead‑time reductions.

## What changed
- Overall supply risk unchanged at 71.0, price trend steady at 84.7; confidence high at 84.2 %【source】.

- TSMC revenue growth (+50.9 % YoY) signals heavier foundry loading, tightening supply further[3].  
- Korea’s October export surge (+171 % YoY) adds demand pressure on the same timeline[4].

- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – lead time 52 weeks (norm ≈12 w), supply risk 83.3 %; price +1,717 % vs target.

## Outlook
- Chip prices in next 3 months: 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.
